# Diona
They cannot wear shoes, but kudzu does not slow them down. They become hungry and thirsty more slowly. Their "blood" is sap, which cannot be replenished with iron. As plants, they are poisoned by herbicide, while Robust Harvest heals them (though overuse is risky!).
They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less blunt damage and 20% less slash damage[/color], but take [color=#ffa500]50% more heat damage, 20% more shock damage, and catch fire easily after taking enough heat damage from any source.[/color]
## Make like a tree and put down roots
When exposed to a large amount of Robust Harvest, a diona begins growing uncontrollably and turns into an immobile tree, dropping all of their equipment. Chopping down the tree can "return" the diona to a mobile state.
## Diona nymphs
After death, a diona can choose to destroy their body and release their "internal organs" as three nymphs, with the player taking control of the brain nymph. It can speak, but has no hands or inventory and can do very little. Its small size allows the nymph to fit inside a satchel or backpack, though it cannot climb in by itself. Its small form also allows it to squeeze through ventilation pipes.
After 10 minutes, the nymph can regenerate into a full diona. It will have a new randomly generated body and a new name, and aside from their own account, almost no trace will remain of who they used to be.
